subject: Banking
title: Wealth Management Fees
description: A micro-lesson that makes Wealth Management Fees usable.

hook.text: Banks charge wealthy clients 1% annually to manage their money.

buildup.text: Wealth management includes investment advice, tax planning, and estate planning.

discovery.text: Morgan Stanley's wealth division manages $5 trillion. At roughly 1% in fees, that's $50 billion in annual revenue.

twist.text: Studies show most managed portfolios underperform index funds.

climax.text: Wealth management sells confidence, not performance. Banks profit from the comfort of having an expert.

punchline.text: 1% fee on trillions. Wealth management sells comfort, not results.

quiz.question: How do most managed portfolios perform compared to index funds?
